```sql

  WHEN P.Age IS NULL OR P.NetWorth IS NULL OR P.Income IS NULL THEN 'Unknown Profile'
  WHEN P.Age < 35 AND P.Income > 200000 THEN 'Young High Earner'
  WHEN P.Age < 35 AND P.NumberChildren > 0 THEN 'Young Family'
  WHEN P.Age < 35 THEN 'Young Adult'

  WHEN P.Age > 55 AND P.NumberCars > 2 THEN 'Senior Multi-Vehicle'
  WHEN P.Age > 55 THEN 'Senior'
  ELSE 'Standard'
END
